notes: RoyalDesign (.com/eu storefront, English, direct HTTP fetch, no WAF). Checked main nav, mega menu, footer nav, homepage embedded state, and candidate URL shapes: /eu/new-arrivals -> 404, /eu/nyheter -> 404, /eu/news -> 200 (linked from homepage nav/footer as 'News'). Confirmed via the site's own route-label config embedded on the homepage: the internal route type 'news' is explicitly mapped to the display prefix 'new arrivals' ("news":{"prefix":"new arrivals"}), and the Swedish source string 'nyheter' translates in-app to 'new arrivals' (translation key nyheter_1f33e972 = 'new arrivals'; RoyalDesign is Swedish and 'Nyheter' is the standard Nordic e-commerce term for newly added products). Opened /eu/news and validated it as a genuine PLP, not a blog/article index: h1='News', og:title='Design News | RoyalDesign.com/eu', and it is backed by the same real product-search index (prod_products_eu) and identical filter set (Brand/Product type/Category/Colour/Material/Price/In stock) used by every ordinary category page on this site -- this is a real, filterable, paginated product grid of newly added items, not editorial content. productsContainer['/eu/news'].totalProducts=506, totalPages=11; ceil(506/48)=11, consistent with the site's stable 48-per-page pagination verified in the prior Home-Decor pass for this domain. Also found a separate editorial/blog 'News' hub (Prismic 'campaign' doc at slug '/news', containing articles like 'September Arrivals - Handpicked Top 9') distinct from the product-listing route at /eu/news -- these are content/inspiration write-ups about new items, not the PLP itself, so excluded per Sec 3 (editorial pages that merely mention new products). No genuine per-category New Arrivals sub-structure (e.g. 'Furniture New Arrivals') found in nav or homepage links -- only the one undifferentiated New Arrivals listing exists.
